root_cause_analysis.symptom: Prior cycle 20260505-124619 closed CLOSE: NO with two source-of-truth-real defects: (1) /usr/lib/node_modules/rednote-mcp/ contains .claude/dev-registry, .codex, INDEX.md, package-lock.json (not part of original sanctioned package); (2) mcp_client.py:184 returns non_text[0] (single first non-text block) instead of the original list of non-text blocks promised by spec line 146 contract.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Defect 1: architect's exclude list prescribed for the M6 widening of deploy-to-usrlib.sh's SOURCE_DIR (from dist/ to package root) listed only 8 excludes (node_modules, .git, src, tests, jest.config.*, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, *.bak) plus 2 deploy-side excludes (dist/.deploy-stamp, dist/auth/cookies.json), missing .claude/, .codex, INDEX.md, package-lock.json, stderr_preinstall_*.txt — the dev-registry and codex/INDEX.md/package-lock.json files exist at source root and were silently rsync'd to install path. Defect 2: M9's implementation rewrote the text-block path to iterate-and-join (closing the visible multi-block bug for text content) but left the non-text fallback narrowed to non_text[0]; AC13 harness only tested text-block cases (sub-tests 1-4) and an empty-content guard (sub-test 5), so the non-text fallback branch was never exercised. The line 146 contract clause 'fall back to returning the original list of non-text blocks' was clear but the implementation used [0] indexing, and the test gap let it ship.

Defect 2: dev's M9 implementation chose a literal interpretation of 'fall back to' as 'return one block' instead of 'return the list of blocks'; AC13's coverage gap allowed the deviation to land.
